standard-dialogue-after-finishing-icthla.player: Hey there. How're you holding up?

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-icthla.npc: Not too bad. Still, I hope we can get rid of these spots soon.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.player: Hey there. How're you holding up?

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-contac.npc: Not too bad. Still, I hope we can get rid of these spots soon.
The embalmer has been importing a soothing balm from a merchant called Ali M. It's meant to stop the itching.
Not even remotely, but it sure does keep the flies away.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-beneat.player: Hey there. How're you holding up?

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-beneat.npc: Much better now that we've finally got rid of those spots.

standard-dialogue-after-finishing-beneat.player: That's great to hear! All the best.

using-a-potion-on-him.player: I thought this acne potion might help ease your spots.

using-a-potion-on-him.npc: What? You intolerable, insufferable idiot. That won't work! I would say get out of my sight but that's not far enough away!

using-a-potion-on-him.player: I was just trying to help.

using-a-potion-on-him.npc: Clear off before I give you something to feel sorry about!
